Slept through night; ibuprofen provided no relief. No prior headache history. Family history of migraine (mother).

  - Tension-type headache: Considered given absence of migrainous accompaniments; unilateral throbbing is less typical.

  - May take acetaminophen (paracetamol) concurrently; dose/route/frequency not documented.
  - Rest and maintain hydration.
  - Safety net: Seek care if worsening pain, new symptoms (fever, rash, vomiting, neck stiffness), recurrent episodes, or if not improving within 1–2 days after trying prescribed medication.
